_comment: The Tier-2 mechanic-adversarial corpus (docs/QUALITY-BENCH.md section 4): per mechanic,
a monster that triggers it, a SMALL bank holding the mechanic's key item(s) plus
better-on-paper distractors, and intent expectations. AdversarialCorpusTest runs each
entry through BOTH the optimizer (VERY_HIGH) and the reference-exhaustive truth oracle
and asserts they agree exactly (truth-regret 0), so any algorithmic change that breaks
a mechanic's reachability fails the BUILD, naming the mechanic. Banks stay tiny so the
exhaustive side costs milliseconds; the test enforces a combination budget per entry.
Item stats are authored for the scenario's purpose (hostile pools), not transcribed
from game data -- the engine values whatever it is handed; what these entries pin is
that the SEARCH reaches the same answer exhaustive enumeration does.
